_README: Builtin command visibility — independent of feature flags. Values: true (visible + executable), false (hidden + blocked), hidden (works but not shown in ? or tab completion). dev mode reveals hidden commands. Use settings/features/ for functional areas; use this file for individual command visibility.
_example_hidden: quit is hidden: still works for muscle memory but not shown in ?
_example_false: To block a command entirely: set it to false
_example_true: To show a previously hidden command: set it to true
